# EVERY JOB THAT MUST HAVE CONCLUDED `success` AT A `v*` TAG BEFORE ANYTHING IS PUBLISHED.
#
# This file is the EXPECTATION, pinned where shrinking it is a reviewable diff instead of a silent
# behaviour change. `scripts/check_tag_jobs.py` compares it to a tag run's jobs by SET EQUALITY —
# never "contains" — so a job that disappears from CI fails as loudly as a job that goes red, and a
# job that appears from nowhere fails too. The comparison is refused outright when this list is
# empty: an expectation of nothing is satisfied by nothing, which is the vacuous-guard hole that a
# populated-set test cannot detect.
#
# The names are the `.name` values the Actions API reports, not the YAML job ids — for a matrix job
# those differ, and the API is what the check reads.
#
#   gh api repos/golyshevskii/tooprolix/actions/runs/<id>/jobs --paginate > ci.json
#   python scripts/check_tag_jobs.py ci.json artifacts.json
#
# Two workflows fire on a `v*` tag: `CI` (.github/workflows/ci.yml) and
# `Build artifacts` (.github/workflows/build-artifacts.yml). `Release-plz` does not — it triggers on
# pushes to `main` only — and `release contract` does not, being `pull_request_target`.
#
# `coverage` is listed even though it is NOT a required status check. Set equality is the point: it
# runs at the tag, so leaving it out would make an otherwise complete run fail. Required-check
# membership is decided by `ci-required`'s `needs:`, not by this file.

ci-python
ci-rust
cargo-doc
coverage
ci-required
sdist (+ the wheel built from it)
wheel linux-x86_64
wheel macos-arm64
wheel windows-x86_64
